description: Figure 2 is a pie chart showing the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages based on the number of utterances. The chart contains six slices: Frustration (light blue) at 25.1%, Neutral (purple/blue) at 23.1%, Anger (yellow) at 14.9%, Sadness (orange) at 14.7%, Excitement (red) at 14.1%, and Happiness (dark blue) at 8.1%. Each slice has its percentage printed inside the segment, and the category names are placed around the outside of the pie; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
